Package net.opengis.gml._3

Class ValueComponents

java.lang.Object
net.opengis.gml._3.ValueComponents
public class ValueComponents extends Object

Java class for ValueArrayPropertyType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="ValueArrayPropertyType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence maxOccurs="unbounded">
         <group ref="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}Value"/>
       </sequence>
       <attGroup ref="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}OwnershipAttributeGroup"/>
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getAbstractValuesAndAbstractGeometriesAndAbstractTimeObjects

      public List<jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBElement<?>> getAbstractValuesAndAbstractGeometriesAndAbstractTimeObjects()
      Gets the value of the abstractValuesAndAbstractGeometriesAndAbstractTimeObjects property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the abstractValuesAndAbstractGeometriesAndAbstractTimeObjects property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getAbstractValuesAndAbstractGeometriesAndAbstractTimeObjects().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list AbstractCurve AbstractGeometricAggregate AbstractGeometricPrimitive AbstractGeometry AbstractImplicitGeometry AbstractScalarValue AbstractScalarValueList AbstractSolid AbstractSurface AbstractTimeComplex AbstractTimeGeometricPrimitive AbstractTimeObject AbstractTimePrimitive AbstractTimeTopologyPrimitive AbstractValue Boolean BooleanList Category CategoryExtent CategoryList CompositeCurve CompositeSolid CompositeSurface CompositeValue Count CountExtent CountList Curve GeometricComplex Grid LineString MultiCurve MultiGeometry MultiPoint MultiSolid MultiSurface Null OrientableCurve OrientableSurface Point Polygon PolyhedralSurface Quantity QuantityExtent QuantityList RectifiedGrid Solid Surface TimeEdge TimeInstant TimeNode TimePeriod TimeTopologyComplex Tin TriangulatedSurface ValueArray
